subject: Atlas AI renewal — concession request & term alignment

From: Michael Lee <michael.lee@atlasai.com>

Cc: procurement@atlasai.com, joel.anders@atlasai.com
Date: 2026-08-30 09:18 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Renewal options — Atlas AI Redwood subscription

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the renewal packet. We reviewed the quote and have a few material concerns before we can move forward:

- The proposed 18% list increase over our current ARR is outside our FY27 planning. We need a path to land within current budget constraints.
- The incident on 2026-06-11 (ticket Q2-1323) materially impacted our production pipelines; we are requesting a one-time credit related to that period.
- Our fiscal year starts Jan 1 — if we can align renewal anniversary to Jan 1, that helps procurement and budget forecasting.
- We need an SLA add-on (99.9% availability) for the first 12 months while we migrate critical models.

Attached is our procurement wishlist and the incident report. Can Redwood provide options (discount, credit, term reset, SLA add-on) and an estimate for impact to ARR/total contract value? We are sensitive to long lead times on approvals.

Proposed next steps: quick call today or tomorrow and then a consolidated concession sheet from your side we can take to legal/procurement.

Best,
Michael Lee
Director of ML Platforms
Atlas AI

Attachments: incident_report_Q2-1323.pdf (pdf), procurement_checklist_AtlasAI.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30 10:02 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Re: Renewal options — Atlas AI Redwood subscription

Michael — thanks for the clear note and the incident report. I can get you a consolidated concession proposal this afternoon, but I need a short internal approval path.

High-level options I will propose to Deal Desk and Sales Leadership:
- One-time incident credit: $50,000 (applied at renewal)
- First-year discount: 15% off list for a 12-month renewal
- Anniversary reset: move renewal to 2027-01-01 (pro-rated first invoicing cycle)
- SLA add-on: 12 months of 99.9% availability with 30-day performance remediation window

If we stack the above, I estimate the net present value impact to Redwood is ~18% of current ARR (pre-credit). I will surface an alternative conservative fallback (12% discount + $25k credit) if Deal Desk needs to tighten authority.

Requesting Deal Desk / Legal:
- Rishi, can you confirm whether the term-reset requires an amendment or a new SOW and whether our billing team can handle a pro-rated Jan 1 start?
- Vivek / Lauren, need signoff authority for discount/credit bands — this will hinge on whether Atlas will commit to a 24-month extension.

I have attached the current quote (q_2026-AtlasAI-renewal-quote.pdf) and a draft SOW snippet for the term reset. I can join procurement's call tomorrow if that helps.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: q_2026-AtlasAI-renewal-quote.pdf, proposed_sow_term-reset.docx

Mina / team — reviewing. A few clarifying Qs before I escalate:

1) Current committed ARR and term length? (I need exact numbers to run the concession analytics.)
2) Is the $50k credit meant to be one-time at renewal or amortized across invoices?
3) Does procurement require the January 1 start to be reflected in the SOW (preferred) or just in the invoice cadence?

Internal policy notes: Exec approval required for
- any one-off credit > $75k, or
- any discount > 20% ARR-equivalent, or
- non-standard billing cadence that requires finance system changes.

If Atlas signs a 24-month commitment we can be more flexible. Please provide the exact ARR and a write-up of the customer justification for the credit (inc. incident timeline + customer impact).

I'll run the initial model with 15% / $50k credit and post the P&L delta. If we need Exec signoff, Lauren / Vivek please confirm whether you want me to route up to the CRO for approval.

Thanks Rishi — quick decision from my side as account owner: approve up to 20% discount and up to $75k credit without CRO escalation provided Atlas executes a 24-month extension and we include the SLA add-on for 12 months.

My recommended final position to send to Atlas:
- Discount: 18% first-year effective (applied on renewal invoice)
- One-time incident credit: $60,000 (applied at renewal)
- Term reset: move anniversary to 2027-01-01 (finance to pro-rate first invoice)
- SLA: 99.9% for 12 months; remediation clause with 30-day cure and defined credits thereafter

Conditions:
1) Must sign 24-month term (so we protect LTV)
2) Legal to accept amended SOW language (Mina — include the SOW snippet)
3) Finance must confirm proration implementation (Monica)

If Lauren is comfortable, I will approve routing to me for final signature authority. Otherwise, I will escalate to CRO.

Vivek
